schema.description: A single IP allow/deny rule on a cluster.

address.description: IP address or CIDR block the rule matches.

allOf.description: Which endpoints an IP rule governs. `ADMIN` covers the cluster's admin console; `REALMS` covers its realm endpoints.
allOf.title: EndpointType

allowDeny.description: `true` when the rule allows the address, `false` when it blocks it.

evaluationOrder.description: Order in which the rule is evaluated within its category.

createdAt.description: When the rule was created, as epoch milliseconds.

schema.title: IpRuleRepresentation
